name: Ningbo Haitian Precision Machinery Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ningbo Haitian Precision Machinery Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells CNC machine tools in China and internationally. The company offers gantry machining, vertical, and horizontal machining centers, CNC turning and vertical lathes centers, and CNC horizontal milling and boring machines. It serves automotive, rail transportation, civil aviation, construction machinery, and other machinery and mold manufacturing industries. The company was formerly known as Ningbo Dagang Tianxin Machinery Co., Ltd. Ningbo Haitian Precision Machinery Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Ningbo, China.
